Fun fact Friday: a golf ball has around 300 to 500 dimples.

They aren't for looks. The dimples cut drag and help the ball stay in the air longer, so a dimpled ball flies much farther than a smooth one would.

Want to see your ball speed, launch and carry on every swing? Our launch monitors track it all. Link in bio to book.

Why 18 holes? Blame St Andrews.

In 1764, the Old Course in Scotland cut its round from 22 holes down to 18. Over time, the rest of the golf world followed.
